== Summary ==

Crop rectangle <code>(128, 607, 1298, 2238)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>050c68aa31a123bf00db200299746b1117e12b5ab4c050ffbb3655f5fc04bfdf</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
